significance.justification: Verified true, the claim would establish a form-(iii) relation: a residual-stream scalar varies monotonically with human-rated harm severity and remains high when jailbreaks flip the binary refusal decision, thereby predicting harmful intent under perturbation. This fixes expectations for an entire class of attacks—successful refusal bypasses should preserve the "graded harm-magnitude projection"—and would materially refine the single-direction causal picture of refusal documented by Arditi et al. (2024), although it establishes a representational mechanism rather than showing that the scalar causally generates harm judgments. The phenomenon and mechanism are determinate enough to distinguish the branches, despite unquantified words such as "largely orthogonal": a negative result would rule out preserved ordinal harm geometry as the basis of this monitor, though not multidimensional or attack-specific harm representations generally. Topic substitution fails: generic mechanistic LLM safety would not itself imply the quoted monotonicity-and-jailbreak-invariance law, so the score reflects the claim-specific conclusion rather than the topic's importance.

reach.justification: The principal handle is a "lightweight internal safety monitor that reads the graded axis and flags harmful intent regardless of whether the model complies," supplemented by using the "graded score to modulate response" between warnings and refusals. It is ex ante relative to unsafe generation because an activation score can gate the response before harmful content is released, giving deployers with internal model access an action window rather than merely explaining a completed failure. After per-model re-extraction, the asserted monotonic severity relation and preservation under jailbreaks predict what should recur, but the stated limitation to "open-weight mid-size models" and dependence on subjective severity calibration constrain uptake, especially for closed APIs. Topic substitution again fails: the broad safety topic alone supplies neither this graded monitor nor its transferable jailbreak-invariance relation, supporting reach above the topic-median probe-and-steering deliverable.
